correctness.rationale: From FAMO Eq. (11), c=(sum z_i/l_i)^(-1), d=c sum_i(z_i/l_i)grad l_i. Under l_i->s_i l_i and g_i->s_i g_i at matched state, log-gradient summands z_i*g_i/l_i remain invariant; w_i=c z_i/l_i define positive simplex weights and c_new/c=(sum_i w_i/s_i)^(-1), so d_new=H_w(s)d. Min/max scale bounds and equal weights (s,1) ->2s/(1+s) follow. Common s gives d_new=s d, hence α_new=α/s and unchanged log-loss differences imply entire same-state model/logit trajectories coincide by induction, if positive adjusted objectives rescale as whole and other hyperparameters match. Direct exact-rational independent worked case and primary verifier formulas corroborate.
